title: Environmental Feedback Modeling Matters: Rethinking Feedback Treatment in Agentic Hindsight Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.11384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning is commonly used to train language agents in interactive environments, but cannot be directly applied when rewards are unavailable. Recent methods use environmental feedback as privileged context for hindsight self-distillation, but our analysis suggests that simply conditioning the teacher on feedback is insufficient, motivating us to rethink how environmental feedback is used in agentic self-distillation. Given that environmental feedback contains rich supervision for modeling how the environment responds to agent actions, we introduce \textit{agentic SElf-distilLation with environmental Feedback modeling} (SELF), a framework that jointly optimizes environmental feedback modeling and hindsight self-distillation. SELF learns to predict environmental responses while distilling guidance from a feedback-conditioned self-teacher into the policy. translated_title: 环境反馈建模至关重要：重新思考智能体后见之明自蒸馏中的反馈处理方式
translated_abstract: 强化学习常被用于在交互环境中训练语言智能体，但当奖励不可获得时便无法直接应用。近来的方法将环境反馈作为特权上下文用于后见之明自蒸馏，但我们的分析表明，仅仅让教师模型以反馈为条件是不够的，这促使我们重新思考在智能体自蒸馏中应如何使用环境反馈。鉴于环境反馈中蕴含着丰富的监督信号，可用于建模环境如何响应智能体的动作，我们提出了带环境反馈建模的智能体自蒸馏框架SELF，它联合优化环境反馈建模与后见之明自蒸馏。SELF在学习预测环境响应的同时，将从以反馈为条件的自教师那里提炼的指导蒸馏到策略中。我们的分析揭示了一种相互增强的机制：环境反馈……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出SELF框架，通过联合优化环境反馈建模与后见之明自蒸馏——即让策略学习预测环境响应、同时从反馈条件化的自教师中蒸馏指导——二者相互增强，从而在无奖励环境下更有效地训练语言智能体。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SELF, a framework that jointly optimizes environmental feedback modeling and hindsight self-distillation—learning to predict environmental responses while distilling guidance from a feedback-conditioned self-teacher—revealing a mutually reinforcing mechanism that enables more effective training of language agents when rewards are unavailable.
